full_text:
ADDENDA (Regulations on Personnel Administration of the Senior Civil Service) <No. 19513, June 12, 2006>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2006.

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (68) Omitted.

(69) The National Emblem Decree is partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 2 of Article 3 is amended to read as follows:

2. Letters of appointment of public officials of Grade I or an equivalent higher grade (including public officials belonging to the Senior Civil Service).

(70) through (241) Omitted.
